summary: 44 features and 9 fixes across HagiCode-org/hagicode-core, HagiCode-org/web.
bodyHtml:
Features

HagiCode-org/hagicode-core

  • claude-helper: add accept-edits permission mode as always-allow (92db9d6)
  • prompts: expand planning direction catalog with change-map, architecture, sequence, and spec-map (c464c58)
  • orleans: add MonoSpec archive auto-commit achievement and repository identity resolution (74f21eb)
  • prompts: add configurable planning directions for proposal generation (d4f052f)
  • signalr: add command execution and scene-aware snapshot for remote voice input (fc866d0)
  • prompts: enforce single JSON output contract in optimization bundle (a985132)
  • orleans: add tool window tracking for executor lifecycle blocks (c1a11b5)
  • signalr: add targeted delivery for remote voice input (7cba5fa)
  • frontend-config: expand UI language support and simplify voice recognition (7a6d97a)
  • copilot: add permission mode and managed CLI path resolution (fb02611)
  • frontend-config: add pull rebase before push preference for AI compose (813cf11)
  • frontend-config: add voice recognition configured and input device fields (7f67a6b)
  • omniroute: share models fetch for runtime and catalog refresh (ed8d95f)
  • signalr: add remote voice input hub with group broadcast (c2162cf)
  • orleans: add thinking buffer to streaming response aggregator (f886006)
  • copilot: add reasoning segment tracking with replay reconciliation (aa30364)
  • serilog: add configurable file rolling with size and retention budget (a26aef2)
  • orleans: propagate Copilot reasoning metadata through execution pipeline (a6b1f79)
  • copilot: add idle timeout, reasoning metadata and response size tracking (d35fe19)
  • steam: add Orleans grain contracts for Steam sync (1068e6f)
  • steam: extend Steam platform client and sync service (5933f4e)
  • steam: add Steam Web API integration (e84cc94)
  • global-achievement: add Steam synchronization state and methods (496a236)
  • steam: add Steam platform integration and achievement sync (3ab7b3a)

HagiCode-org/web

  • proposal: add preview pane to planning-direction dialog and switch to visual selector (1820312)
  • remote-input: localize scene/command labels and refactor remote execution to click buttons (cbb33d0)
  • proposal: wrap planning directions in dialog trigger for compact layouts (f418fb6)
  • proposal: expand planning directions with bilingual content and richer metadata (868ec21)
  • achievement: add monospec.proposal.advanced event and initialize-flow detection (f124507)
  • remote-input: upgrade remote voice input to command-based protocol (84296d7)
  • proposal: replace explore-mode toggle with multi-direction planning selector (b779b24)
  • statusbar: show hero avatars in session list using summary identity (ed46022)
  • proposal: add tab reconciliation and improve stage primary actions (e05cb31)
  • remote-input: replace lease-based groups with per-instance targeting (c8cd695)
  • i18n: expand to 9 supported locales with browser-aware ordering (b11a0bd)
  • git: wire rebase-before-push default into AI commit drawer and settings UI (7603643)
  • settings: add persistent default for AI commit rebase-before-push (7e651b6)
  • monitoring: show probe mode and executable path in AI indicator (2f3e348)
  • statusbar: add adaptive polling and cache to OmniRoute status (6f6e7ad)
  • voice: add remote voice input relay and HagicodeInput component (20447ac)
  • hero: sort hero picker items by profession metadata (30adc09)
  • i18n: add locale metadata and namespace type definitions (d80a05b)
  • i18n: add locale resource generation tooling and tests (3d1cced)
  • i18n: add locale CLI toolkit for YAML management (3fa5c57)

Fixes

HagiCode-org/hagicode-core

  • claude-helper: expand permission-denied terminal failure patterns (92ddd82)
  • claude-helper: handle empty and unknown service tier values gracefully (4fe9045)
  • frontend-config: normalize English language code to en-US (fe18eaa)

HagiCode-org/web

  • conversation: correct ToolDetailModal summary section conditions (8627bf3)
  • message-grouping: keep linked tool results in the same group (47ed4c9)
  • i18n: refine ko-KR and zh-Hant remote-command translations (99f1cd7)
  • session: read latest textarea ref content on send and preserve proposal state (3349f83)
  • chat: reject empty messages before API call (5d56ce6)
  • i18n: update LanguageSwitcher to use en-US code (841ae08)
